# Phase 7A WP-A: Screening-resolution curves

# Work Package A: Screening-resolution curves
For each panel and metric we sweep the top-q fraction from 1% to 50%. At each q we report the observed Jaccard overlap, the exact hypergeometric null, the chance-adjusted Jaccard with a percentile-bootstrap 95% CI, the hypergeometric overlap p-value, the overlap enrichment over null, and the mean rank displacement within the union of the two top-q sets.

- AUC_Concordance = trapezoidal area under adjusted-Jaccard vs q (q in percent).
- q_consensus = smallest q whose lower 95% CI first exceeds 0.0 adjusted Jaccard.
